$comment: The bounded allow-list `fabrika guard i18n-guard check` judges apps/web/src against (#7536, ADR 0347). `exempt` is permanent — text that is not copy. `unmigrated` is debt, each entry naming the issue that clears it. A ceiling is a count, so adding a Turkish literal to a listed file still reds.

apps/web/src/components/authorship/First.why: `tier === "çaylak"` — the wire value the server sends, compared and never rendered.

apps/web/src/components/profile/CaylakSt.why: `tier === "çaylak"` — the wire value the server sends, compared and never rendered.

apps/web/src/components/profile/profileS.why: `case "çaylak":` over the wire tier value; the arm returns a CatalogKey, so the copy is already in the catalog.

apps/web/src/components/sozluk/Sozluk.ts.why: The Turkish alphabet the sözlük indexes by — letters the index is built from, not a sentence any locale could restate.

apps/web/src/lib/panoTags.ts.why: The pano tag vocabulary, stored verbatim on `post_record.tags` — the kinds and their legacy English aliases are wire values. `tagLabel` returning the kind as the rendered label is the separate debt noted on #7658.

apps/web/src/pages/LabComposerPage.tsx.why: The throwaway /lab/composer tiptap spike (#2465) — a lab surface like apps/web/src/lab/, whose exhibit content is exempt from the catalog by LANGUAGE.md's showcase rule.

apps/web/src/pages/WelcomePage.tsx.why: `addressing === "çaylak"` — the wire tier value picking which catalog key to read; every rendered string beside it is already `t(…)`.

apps/web/src/pages/welcomeGating.ts.why: `tier === "çaylak"` — the wire value narrowed into the addressing union, never rendered.

apps/web/src/App.tsx.why: Shell copy the migration children did not reach — the actorLabel fallback, the sözlük nav label, `giriş yap`, `yükleniyor…`. Tracked by #7723. The sixth hit is not copy: `me?.tier === "çaylak"`, the çaylak-meter gate's wire value, compared and never rendered (#7045) — it stays here rather than in `exempt` because an exempt row would shadow this file's five-literal debt ratchet.

apps/web/src/components/controls/Control.why: The density and mode picker labels (`sıkı`, `açık`, `yoğunluk`). Tracked by #7723.

apps/web/src/components/profile/DeleteAc.why: CONFIRMATION_PHRASE — the phrase a reader retypes to delete their account, so it has to read in their locale. Tracked by #7663.

apps/web/src/fate/LoadMoreButton.tsx.why: The pagination button's two states (`yükleniyor…` / `daha fazla`). Tracked by #7723.

apps/web/src/lib/panoNav.ts.why: PANO_FILTERS carries its Turkish label beside its id; the label belongs in the catalog and the id stays the wire value. Tracked by #7658.
